blocks.orig: Climbing Kilimanjaro via the successful 7-day Lemosho Route
blocks.html: Climb Kilimanjaro on the 7-day Lemosho Route with its high success rate

blocks.orig: The Lemosho route is the route with the highest success rate. In addition, this route offers a wonderful panoramic view of the beautiful landscape of West Kilimanjaro. In the second stage of this route, it joins the Machame route. On the way you will pass beautiful landscapes and landmarks such as the famous Barranco wall.
blocks.html: Of all routes, the Lemosho route has the highest success rate. It also gives you a lovely panoramic view over the beautiful scenery of West Kilimanjaro. During its second stage, the route merges with the Machame route. Along the way you pass striking landscapes and landmarks, including the well-known Barranco wall.

blocks.orig: You can do the ascent via the Lemosho route in seven or eight days. The difference between the two routes: the 7-day tour starts at an altitude of 3,500 meters, the 8-day tour starts at an altitude of 2,200 meters. As the 8-day ascent begins at a lower altitude, you hike through the tropical rainforest on the first day. This is not the case for the 7-day ascent. Here you drive by car through the tropical rainforest and only hike through the tropical rainforest on your way back.
blocks.html: The Lemosho route can be climbed in either seven or eight days. What sets the two apart: the 7-day version begins at 3,500 meters, while the 8-day version begins at 2,200 meters. Because the 8-day climb starts lower, your first day is a hike through the tropical rainforest. On the 7-day climb that is not the case. Instead, you are driven through the tropical rainforest and only walk through it on the descent.

blocks.orig: If you want to complete the Lemosho route in six days, this corresponds with the description on the Lemosho-Shira route.
blocks.html: Would you like to do the Lemosho route in six days? Then the description of the Lemosho-Shira route applies.

blocks.orig: Your Tanzania Trip offers a unique service throughout the climb
blocks.html: Your Tanzania Trip provides a special service for the entire climb

blocks.orig: Climbing Kilimanjaro is the ultimate challenge! Little details can make a world of difference, which is why with us, you climb with professional guides, porters, and a cook. They take care of you during your ascent via the Lemosho route, by checking your health twice a day and serving you delicious food. Sounds like a bit much? Not if you want to reach the top! Because we know that altitude sickness can creep up on you unnoticed and that proper nutrition* is essential to keep you going during a strenuous climb.
blocks.html: Climbing Kilimanjaro is the greatest challenge there is! Small things can make a huge difference, so with us you climb with professional guides, porters and a cook. On your ascent of the Lemosho route, they look after you, checking your health twice a day and serving tasty meals. Does that seem excessive? Not if reaching the summit is your aim! We know that altitude sickness can come on without you noticing, and that good nutrition* is vital to keep you going on such a demanding climb.

blocks.orig: Besides, we offer a comprehensive information package to help you prepare for your climb via the Lemosho route.
blocks.html: On top of that, you receive an extensive information package from us so you can get ready for your climb on the Lemosho route.

blocks.orig: *If you would like to see the menu, we can send it in advance.
blocks.html: *Would you like to see the menu? We can send it to you beforehand.

blocks.orig: If you like advice on how to prepare yourself for climbing Kilimanjaro, you can always contact us or read our blog How to prepare for climbing Kilimanjaro?
blocks.html: For tips on getting ready to climb Kilimanjaro, feel free to get in touch with us or read our blog How should you prepare for climbing Kilimanjaro?

blocks.orig: When you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport our Your Tanzania Trip guide is there waiting for you. He then drops you off at your hotel, where you can relax from your flight.
blocks.html: Our Your Tanzania Trip guide is waiting for you as you arrive at Kilimanjaro International Airport. He takes you to your hotel, so you can rest after the flight.

blocks.orig: Preparation for your climb: You meet your guide before the start of your climb, where he briefs you and offers advice on what to wear, what to pack, and other important tips to make your climb as comfortable as possible.
blocks.html: Getting ready for your climb: Before the climb begins you meet your guide, who gives you a briefing and advises you on clothing, packing and other useful tips so the climb is as comfortable as it can be.

blocks.orig: Today you start your incredible journey via the Lemosho Route. Your guide picks you up in the morning and takes you on an approximately 4-hour drive to the western entrance of Kilimanjaro National Park (2,200 m). The road leads through a beautiful tropical rainforest after which you arrive at the drop-off point at 3,500 meters where you can admire the beautiful Shira plateau. The walking route to the first camp is flat which allows you to get used to the high altitude.
blocks.html: Your remarkable Lemosho Route journey begins today. In the morning your guide collects you for a drive of roughly 4 hours to the western gate of Kilimanjaro National Park (2,200 m). The road runs through lovely tropical rainforest, and then you reach the drop-off point at 3,500 meters, with a fine view of the Shira plateau. The trail to the first camp is level, giving you time to adjust to the high altitude.

blocks.orig: In the morning you depart from Shira 1 Camp (3,505 m) to Shira 2 Camp (3,900 m). This walk is not difficult and you can enjoy the breathtaking landscapes and the unique flora of Kilimanjaro's surroundings as you climb higher. On a clear day, Shira 2 Camp is the perfect location to see Mount Meru (the fifth peak of Africa). After lunch, take an acclimatization walk to Lava Tower Camp (elevation gain of 200m) to increase the chances to summit and reduce the chances of altitude sickness.
blocks.html: This morning you walk from Shira 1 Camp (3,505 m) to Shira 2 Camp (3,900 m). It is an easy stretch, and as you gain height you can take in the stunning scenery and the distinctive plants around Kilimanjaro. When the sky is clear, Shira 2 Camp is an ideal spot to see Mount Meru (Africa's fifth peak). After lunch you do an acclimatization walk towards Lava Tower Camp (200m of elevation gain), which improves your chances of reaching the summit and lowers the risk of altitude sickness.

blocks.orig: From Shira Camp 2 to the beautiful Lava Tower at 4,630 m (15,190 ft), you go through many ascents and descents with amazing views along the way. You have lunch at Lava Tower for one to two hours for your body to acclimatize as you might feel uncomfortable with the increase in altitude. After lunch, you descend to Barranco Camp. Watch out for strange-looking flowering plants that grow up to five meters high! Barranco Camp is located at the foot of the imposing Barranco Wall, which is impressive in both its sheer size and steepness.
blocks.html: The walk from Shira Camp 2 to the impressive Lava Tower at 4,630 m (15,190 ft) involves plenty of climbs and descents, with wonderful views all the way. At Lava Tower you take one to two hours for lunch so your body can acclimatize, since the extra altitude may make you feel unwell. Afterwards you head down to Barranco Camp. Keep an eye out for odd-looking flowering plants that can reach five meters in height! Barranco Camp sits at the base of the towering Barranco Wall, remarkable for both its sheer size and its steepness.

blocks.orig: After breakfast, you depart from Barranco Camp to the Barranco Wall. For many people, this is their favourite part of the climb. Once at the top of the Barranco Wall, you have a spectacular view of the Kibo Volcano and Mount Meru.
blocks.html: Once you have had breakfast, you leave Barranco Camp and set off for the Barranco Wall. Many climbers say this is the best part of the whole route. From the top of the Barranco Wall you get a superb view of Mount Meru and the Kibo Volcano.

blocks.orig: Afterwards, a more difficult hike starts to reach Karanga Camp. This route has many ascents and descents, so keep the right pace. You have lunch at the camp and after a rest, you can take an acclimatization hike in the direction of Barafu Camp.
blocks.html: Next comes a tougher hike to Karanga Camp. The trail goes up and down a lot, so make sure you keep a steady pace. Lunch is served at the camp, and after resting you can do an acclimatization hike towards Barafu Camp.

blocks.orig: Barafu Camp is the starting point for your ascent to the Uhuru Peak - the top of Kilimanjaro! You start after breakfast and arrive at the camp around lunch. Have a rest and after you regain your strength, take an acclimatization hike to Kosovo Summit Camp (4,870m) and back. Enjoy breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks and experience the thrill of high-altitude camping as you prepare for the final push to the summit around midnight.
blocks.html: From Barafu Camp you begin your ascent to Uhuru Peak, the summit of Kilimanjaro! You set off after breakfast and reach the camp at about lunchtime. Take a rest, and once you feel stronger again, do an acclimatization hike to Kosovo Summit Camp (4,870m) and back. Take in the stunning views of the peaks around you and feel the excitement of camping at high altitude while you get ready for the final summit push around midnight.

blocks.orig: Today is the day! Around midnight you start from Barafu Camp to Uhuru Peak. The climb leads over good trails and the most challenging part is the high altitude. Once you reach the summit you can enjoy a beautiful sunrise, which is quite impressive at this height! After a short time at the top, where you celebrate your ultimate triumph, you descend slowly to the scenic Millennium Camp.
blocks.html: This is the big day! At about midnight you leave Barafu Camp for Uhuru Peak. The trails are good, and the hardest part is the high altitude. On the summit you can watch a lovely sunrise, which is truly impressive from up here! You spend a short while at the top celebrating your achievement, then make your way slowly down to the scenic Millennium Camp.

blocks.orig: The Millennium camp is located in a tropical rainforest. When you wake up today, you feel a sense of relief from the reduced altitude and satisfaction from reaching the summit. After breakfast, you take an easy walk to the park exit.
blocks.html: Millennium camp lies in tropical rainforest. Waking up this morning, you feel relieved at the lower altitude and proud of having reached the summit. Following breakfast, an easy walk brings you to the park exit.

blocks.orig: Your driver then takes you back to the hotel for a well-deserved rest!
blocks.html: From there your driver brings you back to the hotel, where you can enjoy a well-earned rest!

blocks.orig: Sadly, this is the end of your holiday and the time to go home has arrived. Enjoy your last hours in Tanzania before our driver comes to pick you up and takes you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight home. Still longing for more? It's also possible to add a few days of safari or a beach holiday to your Kilimanjaro adventure!
blocks.html: Unfortunately your holiday has come to an end and it is time to travel home. Make the most of your final hours in Tanzania until our driver collects you and brings you to Kilimanjaro International Airport for your flight back. Not ready to leave yet? You can also extend your Kilimanjaro adventure with a few days of safari or a beach holiday!
